facts.text: Admitted California seniors with a 3.5 GPA or higher who qualify for a Cal Grant receive full tuition.

sources.title: Redlands Tuition Promise
sources.quote: As an admitted high school senior from California with a 3.5 GPA or higher who meets income qualifications to be eligible for a Cal Grant you will receive a scholarship that covers full tuition in 2027-28.

facts.text: Out-of-state seniors admitted with a 3.0 GPA or higher pay no more than $27,000 for tuition.

sources.title: Redlands Tuition Promise
sources.quote: As an out-of-state admitted high school senior with a 3.0 GPA or higher, you'll pay no more than $27K for tuition in 2027-28.
